remarks: 24 HOUR GUARD GATED COMMUNITY |  MAIN LEVEL BEDROOM  |  PRIVATE POOL  &  SPA |  COASTAL ENTERTAINER’S DREAM HOME! Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings, a sweeping staircase and a living room framed by windows that fill the home with natural light. The kitchen opens to the family room and its sleek gas fireplace, creating the bright, airy great room everyone loves.
